subtitle: Connect your account to run campaigns
connect_desc: We'll send you to Google to give Hontrio access to Google Ads and Merchant Center. We read campaigns, budgets, results, search terms and product statuses. We create and look after Hontrio's campaigns in your account and add a “Hontrio” data source in Merchant Center; your existing campaigns change only if you choose so at launch. You pay Google directly for the ads, and you can revoke access at any time.
no_account: No Google Ads account? Create one
revoked_desc: Hontrio's access to your Google account was revoked or expired. Reconnect the account to continue.
no_accounts: We found no Google Ads advertiser account for this Google user. Check that you have access to the store's account or connect another Google user.
disconnect_confirm: Disconnect your Google account? Hontrio will no longer be able to manage your campaigns.
error_missing_scope: Google Ads access must be checked on the Google screen. Please try again.
error_no_refresh_token: Google did not grant permanent access. Please try again.
error_state: The connection session expired. Please try again.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error_not_configured: Google connection is not configured on the server.
error_generic: The Google connection failed. Please try again.
warning_test_token: Your Google account is connected, but Hontrio currently has test-level Google Ads API access only, so it can read test accounts only.
warning_discovery_failed: Your Google account is connected, but we could not read your Google Ads accounts. Click “Refresh”.
warning_generic: Your Google account is connected, but Google Ads returned an error: {{code}}
per_store_hint: Each store runs its campaigns in its own account.
currency_mismatch: The account currency ({{account}}) differs from the store's ({{store}}): budgets and sale values wouldn't match.
no_store: Connect a store first, then choose its Google Ads account.
clear_account: Don't use any account for this store
